item.title: Global container rates slide for fifth consecutive week in weakening market

item.title: DP World announces top leadership change
item.description: Dubai-based logistics giant DP World today announced a major change in its corporate leadership, appointing Yuvraj Narayan, Chief Financial Officer since 2005, as new Group Chief Executive, and Essa Kazim, Governor of the Dubai International Financial Centre, as new Chairman. item.title: Hapag-Lloyd concludes $4B merger agreement with ZIM
item.description: Hapag-Lloyd today signed an agreement with ZIM Integrated Shipping Services Ltd., the world’s 10th largest container shipping line, under which Hapag-Lloyd will acquire 100% of ZIM’s shares for a consideration of USD 35.00 per share in cash. The total transaction value amounts to over US$4 billion.
